evidence.claim: Silencing MDNs impaired backward walking when flies encountered an impassable barrier in Bidaye et al.’s assay.
evidence.context: Adult Drosophila under the reported targeted-silencing and barrier assay conditions.
evidence.caution: This is an assay-specific impairment result, not a claim that MDNs are the only route to every form of backward locomotion.

sourceSupport.locator: Abstract (PMID 24700860); Science 344:97–101

evidence.label: MDN recruitment and turning bias
evidence.claim: In Sen et al.’s stochastic activation assay, total MDN recruitment tracked backward translation, while asymmetric recruitment biased backward turning.
evidence.context: Stochastic activation in adult Drosophila; asymmetric activation favored contralateral backward turning in the reported assay.
evidence.caution: Do not restate this as a universal rule that symmetric recruitment always yields straight retreat or that one simulator control unit equals one recruited neuron.

sourceSupport.locator: Fig. 4A–C and Movie S4; Current Biology 27:766–771
sourceSupport.supports: Supports activation-linked retreat and asymmetric left/right MDN recruitment as a turning mechanism in the reported assay.

evidence.label: Giant fibers causally bias short-mode escape
evidence.claim: Under the cited adult assays, targeted giant-fiber activation elicited short-mode escape and giant-fiber silencing reduced the short-mode escape response; spike timing selected the fast takeoff pathway relative to parallel escape circuits.
evidence.context: Adult Drosophila exposed to looming stimuli, with targeted GF activation/silencing and intracellular recording in source-specific preparations.
evidence.caution: This does not imply every natural takeoff uses the GF pathway, does not calibrate a continuous activation dose, and does not support a whole-brain simulation.

response_latency_ms.label: Response latency
response_latency_ms.formula: run = response_initiated ? clamp(intercept_ms + (1 - effective_motor_drive) * inverse_drive_gain_ms + paired_latency_noise, minimum_ms, trial_duration_ms - onset_ms) : null; condition = responsive_n > 0 ? sum(responsive run latency) / responsive_n : null
response_latency_ms.signConvention: Nonnegative elapsed time measured from nominal protocol onset; smaller values are earlier responses.
response_latency_ms.aggregation: Arithmetic mean across responsive runs only; responsive_n is reported separately.
response_latency_ms.nullRule: Run value is null when response_initiated is false; condition value is null when responsive_n is 0.
response_latency_ms.windowSemantics: Protocol-full-trial scalar. Method v4 supports the analysis window [0, trial_duration_ms] only; response-dependent integration begins at nominal onset plus response latency and ends at trial_duration_ms.
response_latency_ms.boundary: Derived only from seeded outputs of the hand-authored, uncalibrated reduced-order FlyLab model. It is not a measured biological quantity, confidence interval, or independent validation.
